backup.section_desc_steam_lua: Planned — Steam Lua files are not included until a validated file allowlist and safe restore flow are available

backup.audit_manual_games: Exports manually added game entries from manualGameStore
backup.audit_playtime: Exports session durations, totals, and lastPlayedAt
backup.audit_profile: Exports user profile (avatar, banner, display name)
backup.audit_achievement_inputs: Partial. Reads achievement JSONs from disk via Rust with SHA-256 checksums.
backup.audit_custom_artwork: Planned — reads game-activities, not real artwork files. Not selectable.
backup.audit_steam_lua: Partial. Reads .lua files from disk via Rust with SHA-256 checksums. Missing full rollback on partial failure.
backup.audit_ui_preferences: Exports only visual fields from lumaforge-settings (28 keys) plus lumaforge-theme and lumaforge-surface-mode.
backup.preset_essentials_desc: Settings, integrations, favorites, profile, manual games, provider overrides
backup.preset_customization_desc: User profile, theme, and visual settings — never touches paths or keys
backup.preset_full_desc: {{count}} verified sections. Partial sections excluded until they provide complete data.
